name: extension
description: The mission is to give more consumer transparency about where products on Amazon are made.

scripts.build:dev: webpack --config webpack.config.js --mode development && cp manifest.json ./dist/manifest.json && cp -a ./assets/. ./dist/ && cp ./src/popup.html ./dist/popup.html
scripts.build:prod: webpack --config webpack.config.js --mode production && cp manifest.json ./dist/manifest.json && cp -a ./assets/. ./dist/ && cp ./src/popup.html ./dist/popup.html
